app.name: BagCue
app.summary: Offline-first daily packing assistant that merges reusable activity kits into one dated checklist.
app.firstPublicDistribution: Google Play without a product-level country restriction

requirements.title: Execute and complete a packing checklist
Monetize only after a complete successful result
Preserve user work on persistence failures
Accounts and cloud synchronization
requirements.reason: MVP is local-first and must work without an account or product backend.

requirements.title: Automatic weekly activity schedules
requirements.reason: Users manually create dated sessions; recurring schedule automation is deferred until the core behavior is validated.

requirements.title: Persistent bag inventory
requirements.reason: Bag names are grouping labels only; automatic carry-over could falsely claim that an item remains packed.

requirements.title: Import and export
requirements.reason: Local manual data and a small MVP scope do not justify backup interchange in the first release.

requirements.title: AI, OCR, geolocation, and automatic item detection
requirements.reason: These capabilities add privacy, licensing, size, and reliability costs without being needed for the packing value proposition.

requirements.title: Travel planning, family sharing, and school integrations
requirements.reason: The approved first segment is an individual working adult with recurring work-plus-activity days.

requirements.title: Advertising mediation and personalized analytics audiences
requirements.reason: The release uses Yandex Mobile Ads only, no mediation, no advertising identifier, and Firebase Analytics is not linked to advertising.

qualityGates.title: Repository tests, Detekt, Kover, resources, and builds
qualityGates.verificationMethod: Run the exact focused tests, generated Detekt config validation, filtered Kover verification, localization scans, resource compilation, and debug builds declared in quality.md.

qualityGates.title: Android application and platform verification
qualityGates.verificationMethod: Compile, test, install-smoke, and verify notifications, the committed androidApp/google-services.json for the exact Android application ID, privacy-before-ad-init, and disabled Advertising ID; no GitHub secret is used for the Firebase service file.

qualityGates.title: iOS Test and link on macOS
qualityGates.verificationMethod: For the candidate commit, require a successful macOS CI Test and link iOS job that packages the committed iosApp/iosApp/GoogleService-Info.plist for com.sedsoftware.bagcue.iosApp, resolves CocoaPods/Yandex linkage, keeps advertising configuration nullable, and makes no ad request in CI; no GitHub secret is used for the Firebase service file.

qualityGates.title: Release acceptance
qualityGates.verificationMethod: Verify the complete release checklist for the candidate commit, current receipts, approved goldens, ordered Lazyweb post-golden reviews, privacy artifacts, and macOS hand-off guide. Initial external setup completion does not replace candidate-specific evidence.

qualityGates.title: Google Play setup and Internal publication
qualityGates.condition: An Android build is being published to Google Play.
qualityGates.verificationMethod: Verify the completed developer account, protected publishing environment, signing, EN/RU listing, approved Data Safety answers, canonical policy URL https://sedsoftware.com/apps/bagcue/policy.html, countries and credentials, then retain the actual Internal-track publication result for the exact release tag.

qualityGates.title: Asset creation and production usage
qualityGates.verificationMethod: Run validate-assets.py, compile Compose Resources, and inspect production preview/golden evidence for every ASSET ID and launcher derivative.

qualityGates.title: Advertising, privacy, and analytics contract
qualityGates.verificationMethod: Run controlled endpoint, consent, ad lifecycle, Firebase allowlist, identifier-disablement, retention-configuration, and no-user-content checks.

qualityGates.title: Production privacy-region endpoint
qualityGates.verificationMethod: With legal review and policy ownership already approved, verify the remaining technical endpoint contract: HTTPS behavior, schema, policy version, maximum 72-hour expiry, protected/non-protected/unknown routes, spoof resistance, redacted logs, GeoIP freshness, and operational ownership.

qualityGates.title: Android Yandex production ad unit
qualityGates.condition: A monetized Android release is being assembled for public distribution.
qualityGates.verificationMethod: Verify ownership of production ad unit R-M-19857241-1, release-only injection, debug/test separation, and retain the controlled physical-device diagnostic for the exact candidate build.

qualityGates.title: macOS continuation guide
qualityGates.verificationMethod: Verify a project-specific Markdown guide in docs with current commands, prerequisites, remaining native setup, CI parity, expected outputs, and no unverified success claims.

qualityGates.title: Firebase project and Analytics property
qualityGates.condition: Usage analytics is included in a public Android or iOS build.
qualityGates.verificationMethod: Verify ownership of Firebase project bagcue, exact Android/Apple app registration, matching committed service files at androidApp/google-services.json and iosApp/iosApp/GoogleService-Info.plist with no GitHub-secret copies, packaged configuration, two-month user/event retention, disabled Ads linking/signals/personalization, and applicable store disclosure.

qualityGates.title: Privacy policy and store disclosure parity
qualityGates.verificationMethod: Verify that the legally reviewed source and canonical hosted policy at https://sedsoftware.com/apps/bagcue/policy.html remain byte-identical at the approved hash, that Android/iOS open that URL, and that candidate-specific store disclosures match the shipped SDKs, events, permissions, identifiers, retention, deletion behavior, and endpoint.

constraints.offlineMode: Catalog, templates, sessions, history, and local reminders work offline. Endpoint, Analytics, and Ads failures never block core packing.
privacy: No account, precise location, advertising identifier, user-content telemetry, analytics User-ID, Google Signals, or Analytics-to-Ads linking.
Yandex Ads initialization and requests require the current privacy-region and consent gate.
Firebase Analytics is disabled by default and can be enabled or disabled only by the user in Settings.
accessibility: Material 3 semantics, 48dp targets, screen-reader order/state announcements, non-color cues, keyboard/pointer support, reduced motion, and 200% font scale.
performance: Opening the current session and checking an item must feel immediate from local state.
Network initialization is asynchronous and never delays packing.
constraints.audience: Adults 18+; no age gate or date-of-birth collection.
constraints.quantities: Positive integers from 1 through 99; no measurement units.
constraints.sessionUniqueness: Exactly one PackingSession of any status per local calendar date.

architecture.screenshotTestHostRationale: The Compose UI and resource-owning module owns production previews, themes, localized resources, generated Paparazzi tests, and snapshots for both declared targets.

uiQuality.motion: restrained Material 3 expressive intent with baseline fallback and reduced-motion behavior
uiQuality.themePolicy: system light/dark only; static brand scheme; no dynamic color and no in-app theme switch
